launchers.bin/cubehandler-render:
#!/bin/sh
root=@PREFIX@
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$root/lib${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:+:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH}"
export VTK_DEFAULT_OPENGL_WINDOW=vtkEGLRenderWindow
export EGL_PLATFORM=surfaceless
export LIBGL_ALWAYS_SOFTWARE=1
export GALLIUM_DRIVER=llvmpipe
export LP_NUM_THREADS=1
export LIBGL_DRIVERS_PATH="$root/lib/dri"
export __EGL_VENDOR_LIBRARY_FILENAMES="$root/share/glvnd/egl_vendor.d/50_mesa.json"
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1
export OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1
exec "$root/bin/cubehandler" "$@"

checks: import ctypes, sys; import pyvista, vtk; ctypes.CDLL(sys.prefix + '/lib/libEGL.so.1'); assert hasattr(vtk, 'vtkEGLRenderWindow'); print(pyvista.__version__, vtk.vtkVersion.GetVTKVersion())
